title.orig: To make a prairie it takes a clover and one bee
title.en: To make a prairie it takes a clover and one bee
title.zh: 造一片草原，需要一株三叶草和一只蜜蜂

edition.en: Poems, Third Series (1896), edited by Mabel Loomis Todd, on Project Gutenberg (eBook 12242)
edition.zh: 据古登堡计划电子书 12242 所录《诗集·第三辑》（1896），托德编

basis.en: First published in 1896 in Poems, Third Series, after the author’s death in 1886; the editor, Mabel Loomis Todd, died in 1932.
basis.zh: 1896 年首次出版于《诗集·第三辑》，作者已于 1886 年去世；编者梅布尔·卢米斯·托德卒于 1932 年。

note.en: Five lines: a recipe for a prairie, with an escape clause. If the bees are few, imagination will do. It is the shortest proof on this shelf that a reader brings half of every landscape.
note.zh: 五行：一张造草原的配方，附带一条退路——蜜蜂不够，遐想就够了。这是这排架子上最短的证明：每一片风景，都有一半是读者带来的。

excerpt.orig:
The revery alone will do
If bees are few.
excerpt.en:
The revery alone will do
If bees are few.
excerpt.zh:
要是蜜蜂太少，
单有遐想也行。
